description: This file manages the loading and installation of the LanceDB runtime environment, including dependency resolution, runtime manifest handling, and dynamic module importation.

methods.name: defaultReadPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a package.json file at the given path.

methods.name: buildMemoryLanceDbManifestCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidate paths for the memory-lancedb package.json based on the module path.

methods.name: resolveLanceDbDependencySpec
methods.description: Resolves the version specification of '@lancedb/lancedb' from package.json files.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDir
methods.description: Constructs the runtime directory path based on the state directory.

methods.name: readRuntimeManifest
methods.description: Reads and parses a runtime manifest JSON file.

methods.name: manifestsMatch
methods.description: Checks if two runtime manifests are equivalent.

methods.name: defaultResolveRuntimeEntry
methods.description: Resolves the runtime entry point for the LanceDB runtime, verifying manifest match.

methods.name: collectSpawnOutput
methods.description: Executes a command in a child process and collects stdout, stderr, and exit code.

methods.name: defaultInstallRuntime
methods.description: Installs or updates the LanceDB runtime dependencies via npm.

methods.name: defaultImportResolved
methods.description: Dynamically imports a module from a resolved file path.

methods.name: buildLoadFailureMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message string for load failures.

methods.name: createLanceDbRuntimeLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader object to manage the asynchronous loading of the LanceDB runtime module.

methods.name: loadLanceDbModule
methods.description: Exports a function to load the LanceDB module, using the default loader.
